title: Greifeinheit für das Vakuumgehäuse einer Aufnahmevorrichtung

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a gripping unit (Greifeinheit) which implies a housing for gripping, and the plunger (Stößel) is a cylinder body (Zylinderkörper) which is a hollow body.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum housing and a suction device connectable to the vacuum, but does not describe an electrically operated vacuum generating device within the housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe the routing of exhaust air through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a receiving suction device (Aufnahmesauger) at the lower end of the plunger, which functions as a suction plate, but does not explicitly mention a separate carrier plate or a seal extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a grip unit with a hollow grip portion (the cylinder body), but lacks an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routing through the grip, and sound-damping.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference describes a gripping unit (Greifeinheit) with a receiving suction device (Aufnahmesauger) at its lower end, combined in a device for transferring objects.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum housing and a suction device connectable to the vacuum, but does not describe a vacuum generating device or its arrangement within a specific housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference describes a cylinder body as part of the plunger but does not detail its elongation between housing portions or an air outlet on a second housing portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe any air collection screw or exhaust air collection.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe any air baffles or exhaust air direction.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles for exhaust air.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a plunger with a suction device at its end, but not a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 1) The reference states that the suction device (Sauger) is connectable to the vacuum prevailing in the vacuum housing, implying a fluidic connection from the grip unit (which contains the plunger and valve) to the suction device.
